shared_elements: upright stone shaft/pillar with carved relief on its face
low-relief carving executed on a vertical monolithic surface
justification: Both show a standing carved pillar bearing relief imagery on its vertical face, and B's shallow relief may depict an animal figure while A depicts a densely dressed frontal human figure with elaborate headdress, ornaments and panels of small sign-like blocks. Beyond the generic idea of a decorated upright shaft, the depicted content diverges completely: A is a crowded, ornament-laden anthropomorph covering the whole surface, B is a sparse, isolated, minimally modelled motif on an otherwise plain shaft.
